notes.title: Update 1.0.8
notes.content:
[h1]The Balancing Update[/h1]

Since the release of Biodrone Battle, players often complained about the game being too hard. First of all, the game was designed and meant to be on the tougher side. Instant death is still waiting behind each door. So, watch out where you are going, morph into the right drones and don't hesitate to run and hide (be sure to try the stealth mode). Also, take a look into the game guide.
However, this update should make it easier to grab a useful drone on the first floor. Furthermore, various balancing changes create an overall smoother gaming experience.

[b]Input tips[/b]
[list]
[*]Press X to open the morph pool
[*]For hiding, press C to enter the stealth mode
[/list]

[b]Update summary[/b]
[list]
[*]weakened drones of first level for an easier start
[*]overall game balancing
[*]fixed rare crashes when the soundcard does not support OpenAL properly
[/list]
